title: PLAXIS workflows and connector status
description: Explore PLAXIS workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

Bentley Systems

PLAXIS

PLAXIS supports finite-element analysis for soil, rock and geotechnical deformation.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Build a ground model

Begin with the idealised geometry, material assumptions and analysis scope. In the intended PLAXIS preview, build a ground model; the visible result is a solver-ready model view with mesh regions and constraints exposed. Review units, connectivity, mesh suitability and model assumptions before accepting or exporting it.

Stage excavation or loading

Use the selected load cases, contacts and solution controls. In the intended PLAXIS preview, stage excavation or loading; the visible result is a configured analysis state with loads and boundary conditions visible. Review load paths, restraints, convergence controls and applicable codes before accepting or exporting it.

Review deformation and safety

Start from the completed result set and acceptance quantities. In the intended PLAXIS preview, review deformation and safety; the visible result is plots or tables that connect response values to the model. Review convergence, sensitivity, units and engineering reasonableness before accepting or exporting it.
